annotations.title: Schedule, update, go live on or cancel an X broadcast

description: Schedule, update, go live on, or cancel an X LIVE VIDEO broadcast on the connected account. action 'schedule' needs sourceId (from manage_x_stream_source), startAt, and manualPublish, which is REQUIRED with no default: true = nothing airs until action 'go_live'; false = X puts the brand ON AIR automatically at startAt (needs confirm:true). 'update' changes only the fields you pass (Hermoso re-sends the rest, because X's update replaces the whole schedule). 'go_live' airs a manualPublish schedule NOW, publicly, as the brand (confirm:true). 'cancel' deletes a schedule and cannot be undone (confirm:true). X retired recurring broadcasts: schedule each occurrence on its own. WITHOUT A SCHEDULE: 'create' puts sourceId ON AIR NOW (confirm:true; X announces it in a post unless skipPost:true, and ends it if no video arrives within 5 minutes; X retired the separate 'publish' step), 'end' stops one for everyone (confirm:true), 'delete' removes one and its replay (confirm:true; end it first). X limits broadcasting by account (Premium or 1,000 followers) and says so. Confirm the exact broadcast, time and stream with the user before passing confirm:true; a refusal is free. Needs X connected with the broadcast permissions added 2026-09-21: an X connection made before then must be reconnected once under Connectors > X (the tool says so without calling X). Costs credits (X bills per call).

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected

action.description: schedule, update, go_live, cancel, create, end or delete

availableForReplay.description: true = keep the broadcast available as a replay

confirm.description: true only after the user approved this exact public or irreversible action

endAt.description: ISO 8601 or epoch ms; X requires one on update

id.description: broadcast id, for every action but schedule and create

isLocked.description: true = lock the broadcast (X's isLocked flag)

manualPublish.description: required on schedule: true waits for go_live, false auto-publishes at startAt

skipPost.description: create: true skips the post X would make announcing it

sourceId.description: stream source id from manage_x_stream_source (schedule, create)
